summary: Belite Bio filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited third-quarter 2026 financial results and a corporate update via press release. Disclosures center on the tinlarebant NDA for Stargardt disease type 1, accepted by the FDA with Priority Review and a PDUFA target action date of February 12, 2027; the FDA will not convene an advisory committee. The company also submitted a Japanese J-NDA under Sakigake designation and Access Consortium applications in Singapore, the UK and Switzerland, and uplisted to Nasdaq Global Select. No transaction, ownership, or structural special-situation terms are present; watch the PDUFA date as the key binary catalyst.
